sidecar_purpose: Repo-resident semantic image sidecar for the approved one-page Patch Fairytale, The Sorcerer’s Apprentice, and deterministic reconstruction of its layered composition.
summary: Approved one-page Patch Fairytale, The Sorcerer’s Apprentice: a layered editorial composition combines the healthy five-worker opening handoff, a circular magnified view of the mundane recursive-delegation instruction, the full-canvas runaway worker field, and a corrective Delegation Policy prop. The page lands the lesson that delegation needs a boundary, not just permission.

composition: Landscape one-page fairytale with PATCH FAIRYTALES branding and the title “The Sorcerer’s Apprentice”.
The approved runaway recursive-delegation scene supplies the full background canvas.
The opening handoff scene is overlaid in the upper-left as a bordered panel.
The circular instruction insert hangs from the lower-right region of the opening panel and is connected by a straight leader line to the lower part of Patch’s handed-over document.
The Delegation Policy prop is overlaid at bottom-right while the runaway background remains visible around and behind it.
The lesson block sits in lower-left negative space and reads “Delegation needs a boundary, not just permission.”
scene_semantics: The opening delegation looks competent and sensible; the failure is not the initial use of subagents.
The magnified instruction identifies the missing operating-policy boundary that allows each worker to repeat the same locally sensible delegation choice.
The runaway background shows uncontrolled recursive fan-out without portraying workers as malicious or incompetent.
The policy prop provides the corrective pattern: explicit limits on fan-out, depth, inherited capability, and escalation.

positive_constraints: Use as the approved final-candidate one-page Sorcerer’s Apprentice fairytale.
Preserve the reading order from opening handoff to magnified causal instruction to runaway consequence to corrective policy.
Keep delegation itself framed as useful; the lesson is controlled delegation rather than anti-delegation.
Treat the page as deterministic composition from the accepted source assets rather than a single generated scene.
negative_constraints: Do not convert this fairytale into a triptych, deck, or literal sorcerer-cosplay scene.
Do not remove the circular magnifier or make the causal instruction visually special inside the document itself.
Do not obscure the distinction between initial parallel fan-out and later uncontrolled recursive delegation.
